description: Java class 'GridLayout3' demonstrating the use of Android's GridLayout API to create a form layout with email and password fields, and two buttons, with handling of orientation changes.

classes.name: GridLayout3
classes.description: An Android Activity class that creates a form layout using GridLayout, demonstrating row/column preservation and dynamic view creation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method that constructs and returns a GridLayout with email/password fields and buttons, configured based on device orientation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that sets the activity's content view to the layout created by the create() method.
